DLG-SC-LOC-009-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-009-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 問診票について、ご質問はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have any questions about the medical questionnaire?

DLG-SC-LOC-009-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-009-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この零から十の欄へ十と書きましたが、痛みの強さではなく回数のつもりでした。読み方を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 程度欄の十は回数の意味で書いたと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I wrote ten in this zero-to-ten field, but meant the number of times, not pain severity. I'd like to check how to read it.
DLG-SC-LOC-009-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that the ten in the severity field was intended as a frequency count.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-009-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どのような回数として書かれましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: What kind of count did you mean?

DLG-SC-LOC-009-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-009-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 昨日、痛みが気になった回数です。正確には数えていませんが、十回くらいだったと思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 昨日の痛みが約十回だったが正確には数えていないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: The times the pain bothered me yesterday. I didn't count exactly, but think it was about ten times.
DLG-SC-LOC-009-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that yesterday's pain occurred about ten times but you did not count precisely.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-009-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 程度の欄とは別に、回数として担当へお伝えください。程度の付け方も診療担当に確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please tell the medical staff that as frequency, separately from severity. You can also ask them how to rate severity.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-009-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。回数として書いてしまったことも、担当の方へ伝えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 回数として誤記したことを診療担当にも伝えてもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please. Could you also tell the staff I mistakenly entered a frequency?
DLG-SC-LOC-009-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for the mistaken frequency entry to be passed to medical staff too.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-009-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 回数のメモは、正確に数えた記録ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Is your frequency note an exact count record?

DLG-SC-LOC-009-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-009-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: いいえ、大体の数です。始まった時刻も覚えていません。痛くなる時間をメモしておけばよかったのですが。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 回数は概数で開始時刻の記録はないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: No, it's approximate. I don't remember the start time either. I should have noted when the pain occurred.
DLG-SC-LOC-009-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Answer in Japanese that the count is approximate and no onset-time record exists.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-009-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当へ、程度の確認希望と回数のお話をおつなぎします。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll connect you with staff about checking severity and explaining the frequency.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-009-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 問診票を見せて説明します。程度の欄の意味を聞いてから、今の痛みについて答えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 問診票を示し程度欄の説明を聞いて今の痛みを答えたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll show the questionnaire and explain. I'd like to hear what the severity field means before answering about my current pain.
DLG-SC-LOC-009-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will show the form and answer about current pain after hearing the severity-field explanation.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-009-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。問診票をお持ちになり、担当へご説明ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Take the questionnaire and explain to the medical staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-009-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ちの写真について、何を説明されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: What would you like to explain about your photograph?

DLG-SC-LOC-009-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-009-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 道で見た場面の写真です。矢印は現場にあった印ではなく、私が後から描いた説明なので、その点を先に伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 写真の矢印は本人の後書きだと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: It's a photo of a scene I saw on the road. The arrow wasn't a mark at the location; I drew it later as an explanation, and want to say that first.
DLG-SC-LOC-009-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the photo's arrow is your own later annotation.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-009-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 矢印のない元の画像も残っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you still have the original image without the arrow?

DLG-SC-LOC-009-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-009-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、こちらです。撮った時には矢印はありません。説明用の方だけに足しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 描き込み前の原画像が残っていると示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, here. There was no arrow when I took it. I added it only to the explanatory version.
DLG-SC-LOC-009-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show in Japanese that you still have the original image from before annotation.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-009-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 矢印は、実際に見た動きを示していますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Does the arrow show movement you actually saw?

DLG-SC-LOC-009-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-009-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 自転車がここまで進んだのは見ました。角の先は見ていないので、その先まで伸ばした矢印は推測でした。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 実際に見た移動範囲と矢印の推測部分を区切る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I saw the bicycle move as far as here. I didn't see beyond the corner, so the arrow extending beyond that was my guess.
DLG-SC-LOC-009-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Separate in Japanese the movement you actually saw from the speculative part of the arrow.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-009-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 見えた所と推測した所を分けて説明してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please explain separately what you could see and what you inferred.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-009-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ここまでを直接見ました。元の写真を見ながら、私が立っていた場所も説明していいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 直接見た範囲を示し観察した場所も説明してよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I directly saw this far. While looking at the original photo, may I also explain where I was standing?
DLG-SC-LOC-009-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Indicate what you directly saw and ask in Japanese to explain your observation position too.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-009-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。撮った時刻も分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Do you also know what time you took it?

DLG-SC-LOC-009-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-009-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日の午後一時ごろです。この店の入口に立っていました。こちらが元の写真で、もう一枚には私が矢印を足しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 時刻と観察位置を答え元写真と描き込み版を提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Around one p.m. today. I stood at this shop entrance. This is the original photo, and on the other one I added the arrow.
DLG-SC-LOC-009-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Give the time and observation point in Japanese and present the original and annotated versions.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-009-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。画像に写った内容と、後から加えた説明を分けて伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We'll ask separately about what appears in the image and the explanation added later.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-009-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。こちらのマフラーをご覧になりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Would you like to see this scarf?

DLG-SC-LOC-009-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-009-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 赤と灰色が重なって見えます。二枚の組なら友人と一枚ずつ使えると思いましたが、数量を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二色の見本を二枚の組と思い数量を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I see red and gray overlapping. I thought a set of two would let my friend and me use one each, but could you tell me the quantity?
DLG-SC-LOC-009-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese about quantity after mistaking a two-color display for a two-piece set.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-009-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: これは一枚です。表と裏を折って、両方の柄を見せています。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: This is one scarf. We've folded the front and back to show both patterns.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-009-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一枚だったんですね。友人と自分の分で二枚欲しいので、別の色も見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一枚と理解し二人分のため別色の商品も見せてもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: So it's one. I want two, for myself and my friend, so please show me another color too.
DLG-SC-LOC-009-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you understand it is one scarf and ask to see another color for two people.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-009-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お二人分なら、別々の商品をお選びいただけます。ご希望の色は決まっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: For two people, you can choose separate products. Have you decided the colors?

DLG-SC-LOC-009-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-009-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 友人には灰色、自分には赤を選びたいです。それぞれ一枚ありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 友人用灰色と自分用赤を指定し在庫を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'd like gray for my friend and red for me. Do you have one of each?
DLG-SC-LOC-009-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Specify gray for your friend and red for yourself and ask in Japanese about stock.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-009-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらに一枚ずつございます。お包みは分けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We have one of each here. Shall we wrap them separately?

DLG-SC-LOC-009-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-009-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。友人の灰色だけ贈り物用にお願いします。自分の赤は普段の袋で構いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 灰色だけ贈物包装に分けると頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. Only my friend's gray one needs gift wrapping. A regular bag is fine for my red one.
DLG-SC-LOC-009-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for only the gray scarf to have separate gift wrapping.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-009-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この二枚でよろしいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Are these two the ones you'd like?

DLG-SC-LOC-009-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-009-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、この二枚でお願いします。灰色の方に値札が入らないようにしてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二枚を購入し贈り物に値札を入れないよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, these two please. Could you make sure no price tag is included with the gray one?
DLG-SC-LOC-009-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Buy the two in Japanese and ask to exclude the price tag from the gift.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-009-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。灰色は別にお包みします。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We'll wrap the gray one separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-009-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お弁当をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for a boxed lunch?

DLG-SC-LOC-009-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-009-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。自分の昼食はこのおかずにします。職場にご飯があるので、ご飯なしのものを探していました。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自分には職場にご飯があるためおかずだけの商品を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I'll have these side dishes for my own lunch. There's rice at work, so I was looking for something without rice.
DLG-SC-LOC-009-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Choose in Japanese a side-dish-only product for yourself because you have rice at work.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-009-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらはおかずだけの商品です。ほかにもご覧になりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: This product is side dishes only. Would you like to look at anything else?

DLG-SC-LOC-009-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-009-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今、同僚から昼まで残ることになったと連絡が来ました。同僚にはご飯がないので、弁当も一つ選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 同僚の勤務予定が変わりご飯付き弁当も必要になったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I just heard from a coworker that they now have to stay until lunchtime. They don't have rice, so I'd like to choose one boxed lunch too.
DLG-SC-LOC-009-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that your coworker's schedule changed and you also need a lunch with rice.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-009-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お好みは分かりますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-009-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-009-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 肉より魚がいいと言っています。この魚のお弁当は、ここに並んでいる分だけですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 同僚の魚の希望を伝え対象商品の在庫を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: They said fish rather than meat. For this fish lunch, is the displayed stock all there is?
DLG-SC-LOC-009-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give your coworker's fish preference and ask in Japanese about stock of that product.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-009-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 在庫を確認します。こちらの商品でよろしければ、一つございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll check the stock. If this product is suitable, there is one.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-009-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では、これにします。自分のおかずと一緒に持って帰りますが、会計を別にしてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 弁当を決め自分のおかずと会計を分けられるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I'll take it. I'll carry it with my own side dishes, but could you bill them separately?
DLG-SC-LOC-009-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose the lunch in Japanese and ask for payment separate from your side dishes.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-009-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 別々にお会計できます。お弁当は袋に分けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: We can charge separately. Should the lunch be in a separate bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-009-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-009-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 袋は一つで大丈夫です。弁当のレシートだけ同僚へ渡したいので、分けて手元にください。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 袋は一つにし同僚用のレシートを別に受け取りたいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: One bag is fine. I'd like to give only the lunch receipt to my coworker, so please hand that to me separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-009-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that one bag is fine and ask to receive the coworker's receipt separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-009-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。おかずとお弁当を別々にお会計します。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We'll charge the side dishes and boxed lunch separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-009-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 用紙の記入で、何かお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having trouble filling in the form?

DLG-SC-LOC-009-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-009-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 働き始めた日の欄があります。契約に名前を書いた日とは違うので、どちらを示すか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 契約署名日と実勤務開始日が違うため欄の意味を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: There's a field for the date I started working. It differs from the day I signed the contract, so I'd like to check which it means.
DLG-SC-LOC-009-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese the field's meaning because contract signature and actual work start differ.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-009-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: それぞれの日は分かりますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-009-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-009-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 契約を書いたのは四月二十日、実際に仕事を始めたのは五月一日です。書類の日だけを見ていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 四月二十日契約と五月一日勤務開始を具体的に伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I signed the contract April 20 and actually began work May 1. I had only been looking at the document's date.
DLG-SC-LOC-009-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give April 20 contract and May 1 work start specifically in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-009-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この欄は、実際に仕事を始めた日を伺っています。確認資料が必要かは担当へ照会します。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: This field asks the actual first day of work. I'll ask the adviser whether supporting documents are needed.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-009-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 五月一日ですね。ここへ書きます。勤務開始の案内も持っていますが、提出する必要がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 勤務開始日を記入し勤務開始案内の提出要否を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: May 1, then. I'll write it here. I also brought the work-start notice; do I need to submit it?
DLG-SC-LOC-009-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Enter the work start date and ask in Japanese whether the work-start notice needs submission.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-009-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 開始日の記録は、お手元にありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you have the start-date record at hand?

DLG-SC-LOC-009-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-009-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、この会社からの案内です。契約書も持っています。どちらを確認していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 勤務開始案内と契約書を示し確認対象を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, this company notice. I have the contract too. Which can you check?
DLG-SC-LOC-009-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the work-start notice and contract and ask in Japanese which will be checked.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-009-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 資料の扱いについては、担当の案内をお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please wait for the adviser's instructions on document handling.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-009-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。記入した用紙と二つの資料を持って、担当の方の案内を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 用紙と二資料を持って担当の案内を待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I'll keep the filled form and both documents with me and await their instructions.
DLG-SC-LOC-009-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will wait for guidance with the form and two documents.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-009-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。二つの日付と資料の内容で担当へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll check with the adviser about both dates and document contents.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-09-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-009-09-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご相談に使う資料についてのお尋ねですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-09-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about materials for a consultation?

DLG-SC-LOC-009-09-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-009-09-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 銀行に入った金額を書いてきました。給与の全額としてよいか分からないので、必要な資料を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-09-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 銀行の給与受取額だけで全額としてよいか資料を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-09-001-SHARED-02.translation: I've written the amount deposited in my bank. I don't know if that can count as my entire salary, so I'd like to check the documents needed.
DLG-SC-LOC-009-09-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether the bank salary receipt alone is the full amount and what documents are needed.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-09-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-009-09-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 会社から受け取った給与明細はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-09-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have payslips from the company?

DLG-SC-LOC-009-09-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-009-09-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、六月分を持っています。支給額と銀行に入った額が違っているので、どちらを書けばよいか迷いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-09-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 六月明細の支給額と振込額が違い記入する額に迷ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-09-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, June's. The gross payment and amount in the bank differ, so I was unsure which to write.
DLG-SC-LOC-009-09-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that June's payslip payment and bank transfer differ, leaving you unsure what to enter.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-09-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-009-09-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 相談の用件と、明細の欄を担当へお示しください。こちらでは数値だけから税額を決めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-09-001-SHARED-05.translation: Show the adviser your inquiry purpose and the payslip fields. We won't determine tax from figures alone here.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-09-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-009-09-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 担当の方に見ていただきたいです。必要な欄が分かるよう、明細を出しておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-09-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 担当者に確認してもらいたく明細を用意すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-09-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'd like the adviser to check. I'll get the payslip ready so the necessary fields can be seen.
DLG-SC-LOC-009-09-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will prepare the payslip for the adviser's confirmation.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-09-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-009-09-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご用意の明細は、いつの分ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-09-001-SHARED-07.translation: Which period is the payslip you have for?

DLG-SC-LOC-009-09-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-009-09-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 六月分だけです。会社へほかの資料も頼むなら、どの期間の分が必要か教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-09-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 六月分しかなく追加資料の対象期間を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-09-001-SHARED-08.translation: Only June. If I need to ask the company for other documents, please tell me which period is needed.
DLG-SC-LOC-009-09-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you have only June and ask the period for additional documents.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-09-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-009-09-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当へ資料の範囲を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-09-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let's confirm the document scope with the adviser.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-09-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-009-09-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では、この明細と銀行の記録を持って相談します。追加で必要な資料が分かったら、会社に頼みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-09-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 手持ち資料で相談し追加資料は会社に頼むと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-09-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I'll consult with this payslip and bank record. Once I know what additional documents are needed, I'll ask the company.
DLG-SC-LOC-009-09-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will consult using current materials and request additional documents from the company.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-09-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-009-09-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。相談に必要な資料と対象期間から確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-09-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We'll start by checking necessary materials and the relevant period.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-10-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-009-10-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 食券をお預かりします。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-10-001-SHARED-01.translation: May I take your meal ticket?

DLG-SC-LOC-009-10-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-009-10-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: すみません。券を買ったはずですが、ポケットにありません。もう一度買う前に相談してもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-10-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 購入済みの食券が見当たらず再購入前に相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-10-001-SHARED-02.translation: Excuse me. I should have bought one, but it isn't in my pocket. May I ask before buying another?
DLG-SC-LOC-009-10-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese before repurchasing because your purchased meal ticket cannot be found.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-10-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-009-10-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 何をご購入になりましたか。いつごろでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-10-001-SHARED-03.translation: What did you buy, and about when?

DLG-SC-LOC-009-10-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-009-10-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: しょうゆラーメン一杯です。五分ほど前に入口の機械で現金を入れ、おつりは受け取りました。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-10-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 購入料理時刻機械と現金の釣銭受領を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-10-001-SHARED-04.translation: One soy-sauce ramen. About five minutes ago at the entrance machine, I inserted cash and received the change.
DLG-SC-LOC-009-10-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State the dish, purchase time, machine and receipt of cash change in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-10-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-009-10-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 食券を受け取ったところは覚えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-10-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do you remember collecting the meal ticket?

DLG-SC-LOC-009-10-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-009-10-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 取りました。子どもの手をつなぐために、一度かばんの上へ置いた気がします。かばんも探してみます。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-10-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 食券受領後にかばんの上へ置いた記憶を説明し捜すと申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-10-001-SHARED-06.translation: I did. I think I put it on my bag briefly to hold my child's hand. I'll search the bag too.
DLG-SC-LOC-009-10-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese your memory of putting the collected ticket on your bag and offer to search.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-10-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-009-10-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 通路を空けてお探しください。ご注文はまだ厨房へ伝えていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-10-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please keep the passage clear while searching. The order hasn't gone to the kitchen yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-10-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-009-10-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 探しましたが見つかりません。子どもと分けて食べるつもりなので、注文は一杯だけです。購入の記録を見てもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-10-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未発見と報告し子どもと分ける一杯だけの購入記録確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-10-001-SHARED-08.translation: I searched but couldn't find it. I plan to share with my child, so the order is only one bowl. Could you check the purchase record?
DLG-SC-LOC-009-10-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report in Japanese that it remains missing and ask to check the record for just one bowl to share with your child.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-10-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-009-10-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認します。まだ買い直さず、この席でお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-10-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll check. Don't buy again yet; please wait at this seat.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-10-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-009-10-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。一杯分の購入が確認できたら、その注文でお願いしたいです。もし確認できない場合は、次の対応を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-10-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 買い直さず待ち購入確認後の注文または未確認時の対応を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-10-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. If the one-bowl purchase is confirmed, I'd like that order. If it can't be confirmed, please tell me what to do next.
DLG-SC-LOC-009-10-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will wait without buying again and want the confirmed order or guidance if confirmation fails.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-10-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-009-10-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。購入状況を確認してからご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-10-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We'll check the purchase status before guiding you.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-11-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-009-11-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 追加のご注文でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-11-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to order more?

DLG-SC-LOC-009-11-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-009-11-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 注文ではなく席の相談です。友人の声が聞こえにくいので、少し静かな席へ移れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-11-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人の声が聞き取りづらいため静かな席への移動を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-11-001-SHARED-02.translation: It's about seating, not an order. I have trouble hearing my friend; can we move to a quieter seat?
DLG-SC-LOC-009-11-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese to move to a quiet seat because your friend's voice is hard to hear.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-11-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-009-11-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 空いている席を確認します。何名様でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-11-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll check available seats. How many people?

DLG-SC-LOC-009-11-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-009-11-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 二人です。料理を二品頼んでいて、一品はまだ来ていません。移ったら、そちらへ運んでもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-11-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二人と伝え注文済みの未提供料理を移動先へ届けてほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-11-001-SHARED-04.translation: Two. We ordered two dishes, and one hasn't arrived yet. If we move, could you bring it there?
DLG-SC-LOC-009-11-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that there are two people and ask for the ordered but undelivered food to go to the new seat.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-11-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-009-11-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 移動できる場合は、注文も確認して引き継ぎます。こちらの席はいかがですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-11-001-SHARED-05.translation: If you can move, we'll check and transfer the order too. How about this seat?

DLG-SC-LOC-009-11-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-009-11-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: そちらでお願いします。ただ、この席の足元に置いた荷物が大きいので、移った先で置けるか見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-11-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 候補席を選び大きい荷物の置き場所を確かめたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-11-001-SHARED-06.translation: That one, please. But the luggage at our feet here is large, so I'd like to see whether it fits at the new place.
DLG-SC-LOC-009-11-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose the candidate seat in Japanese and ask to check space for large luggage.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-11-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-009-11-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 通路を空けて置ける場所をご案内します。お飲み物はスタッフが運びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-11-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll show you somewhere to put it without blocking the passage. Staff will carry the drinks.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-11-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-009-11-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。友人には先に新しい席へ行ってもらい、私は荷物を持ちます。お皿もお願いしていいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-11-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 友人と荷物の移動順を伝え皿も運んでもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-11-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. I'll ask my friend to go to the new seat first and carry the luggage myself. Could you take the plates too?
DLG-SC-LOC-009-11-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese the moving order for your friend and luggage and ask staff to carry plates too.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-11-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-009-11-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、お皿もお運びします。新しい席でご注文の内容を確認しますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-11-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, we'll carry the plates too. We'll confirm your order at the new seat.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-11-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-009-11-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。まだ来ていないのは焼き魚です。追加で同じものを頼んだわけではないので、その一品をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-11-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 未提供は焼き魚一品で追加注文ではないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-11-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please. The dish not yet here is grilled fish. We aren't ordering an additional same dish, so please bring that existing one.
DLG-SC-LOC-009-11-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese the undelivered item is one grilled fish, not an additional order.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-11-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-009-11-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 焼き魚一品が未提供ですね。移動先へお持ちします。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-11-001-SHARED-11.translation: One grilled fish still undelivered, then. We'll bring it to the new seat.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-12-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-009-12-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お二人でお待ち合わせですか。先にご注文を伺いましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-12-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you two meeting someone? Shall I take your order first?

DLG-SC-LOC-009-12-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-009-12-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人がまだ着いていません。私の飲み物だけ先に頼んで、料理は待ってもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-12-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 飲み物だけ先に頼み料理を待てるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-12-001-SHARED-02.translation: My friend hasn't arrived. May I order only my drink first and wait on the food?
DLG-SC-LOC-009-12-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese to order a drink first while delaying food.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-12-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-009-12-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 承知しました。お友達はあとどのくらいで到着されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-12-001-SHARED-03.translation: Understood. About how long until your friend arrives?

DLG-SC-LOC-009-12-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-009-12-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 駅を出たそうなので、もう少しだと思います。ただ、正確な時間は分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-12-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 友人の現在地と到着時刻が不確かなことを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-12-001-SHARED-04.translation: They said they've left the station, so I think a little longer. But I don't know the exact time.
DLG-SC-LOC-009-12-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese your friend's location and uncertain arrival time.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-12-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-009-12-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、料理が決まったらお呼びください。メニューはご覧になりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-12-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then call us when you've chosen the food. Have you looked at the menu?

DLG-SC-LOC-009-12-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-009-12-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。餃子を二人で分けたいですが、友人は焼いたものとゆでたもののどちらを食べたいか、まだ聞いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-12-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 餃子を分けたいが調理方法の好みを未確認と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-12-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I'd like to share dumplings, but haven't asked whether my friend wants pan-fried or boiled ones.
DLG-SC-LOC-009-12-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you want shared dumplings but haven't checked the preferred cooking method.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-12-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-009-12-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お友達に確認してから決めますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-12-001-SHARED-07.translation: Will you decide after asking your friend?

DLG-SC-LOC-009-12-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-009-12-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: そうします。メニューの写真を送って聞いてもいいですか。返事が来たら注文します。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-12-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: メニュー写真を送って友人の希望を聞く許可を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-12-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. May I send a photo of the menu and ask? I'll order once I receive a reply.
DLG-SC-LOC-009-12-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask permission in Japanese to send the menu photo to ask your friend's preference.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-12-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-009-12-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 大丈夫です。お飲み物はこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-12-001-SHARED-09.translation: That's fine. Here is your drink.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-12-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-009-12-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。友人から焼いた餃子がいいと返事が来ました。料理は友人が着いてから、二人で量を決めて頼みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-12-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 友人の希望を伝え到着後に二人で量を決めると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-12-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. My friend replied that they want pan-fried dumplings. For food, we'll decide the quantity together after they arrive and then order.
DLG-SC-LOC-009-12-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Give the preference in Japanese and say you will decide quantity together after arrival.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-12-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-009-12-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 分かりました。おそろいになりましたらお声掛けください。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-12-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Call us when you're both here.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-13-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-009-13-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 展示について、何かお尋ねですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-13-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to ask about the exhibit?

DLG-SC-LOC-009-13-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-009-13-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この絵の高い建物を探していますが、外では見付かりません。今ある建物の図ではないのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-13-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 図の高い建物が現存するか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-13-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm looking for the tall building in this picture, but can't find it outside. Is this not a diagram of buildings that exist now?
DLG-SC-LOC-009-13-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether the tall building in the drawing still exists.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-13-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-009-13-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらは、昔の形を説明する復元図です。現在見える物を全部そのまま描いた図ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-13-001-SHARED-03.translation: This is a reconstruction explaining its former shape. It does not depict everything currently visible exactly as it is.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-13-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-009-13-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 復元図だったんですね。友人に「今も残っている」と伝えてしまったので、訂正します。今見られる所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-13-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 復元図と分かり友人への誤説明を訂正し現物の見学場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-13-001-SHARED-04.translation: So it was a reconstruction. I told my friend it still remained, so I'll correct that. Please tell me where we can see the actual remains.
DLG-SC-LOC-009-13-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will correct the mistaken explanation to your friend and ask where to visit actual features after learning it is a reconstruction.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-13-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-009-13-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 現物を見る時は、こちらの見学通路をお使いください。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-13-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please use this visitor path to see the actual features.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-13-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-009-13-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この通路ですね。絵と見比べながら歩きたいので、案内図も持って行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-13-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 案内された通路で図と見比べながら歩くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-13-001-SHARED-06.translation: This path, then. I'd like to walk while comparing with the picture, so I'll take a guide map too.
DLG-SC-LOC-009-13-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will use the indicated path and compare with the diagram as you walk.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-13-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-009-13-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 説明板も参照されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-13-001-SHARED-07.translation: Will you also refer to the explanation boards?

DLG-SC-LOC-009-13-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-009-13-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。説明板を読んでから、外で見た物について友人に話したいです。図の説明で分からない所があれば、戻って聞いてもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-13-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 説明板を参照し不明点を戻って質問してよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-13-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I'd like to read the board before telling my friend about what I saw outside. If anything in the drawing explanation is unclear, may I return and ask?
DLG-SC-LOC-009-13-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will consult the board and ask whether you may return with questions.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-13-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-009-13-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 図と現在の姿を見比べてみてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-13-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please compare the drawing with the present appearance.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-13-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-009-13-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。まず通路から見てきます。友人にも復元図だったと伝えて、一緒に説明板を読んでもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-13-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 通路で見学し友人へ訂正して一緒に説明板を読むと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-13-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. First I'll look from the path. I'll tell my friend it was a reconstruction and ask them to read the board with me too.
DLG-SC-LOC-009-13-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will visit via the path, correct your friend and read the board together.

DLG-SC-LOC-009-13-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-009-13-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 分かりました。通路からごゆっくりご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-009-13-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please take your time viewing from the path.
